answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a verifiable work vault: before an agent earns spending rights, it must lock a small refundable stake and complete a unique, time-bound task that no duplicate can cheaply repeat. Reputation then grows like a cedar — slow, rooted, and hard to fake — while a violet flag marks identities whose behavior suddenly diverges from their history, triggering re-verification before they can transact again.
